page_title: BUR 2-5 TOT | Burnley v Tottenham Hotspur 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Richarlison (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+4' The attendance is 21750.

90+4' 2 - 5 Brilliant finish! Josh Brownhill (Burnley) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Josh Cullen, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:5.
90+1' Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
88' One of the Tottenham players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
88' The total number of attempts is 15:20.
87' Nathan Redmond (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is behind the touchline and Tottenham will take a throw-in.
86' We are about to witness a subsitution. Emerson Royal (Tottenham) for James Maddison.
86' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) replacing Dejan Kulusevski.
85' Richarlison (Tottenham) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
84' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jack Cork (Burnley) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
83' The percentage of ball possession is – 46:54.
82' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
81' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) has tested the patience of referee Darren England and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Burnley play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Now Burnley have a corner.
78' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Burnley will have a corner.

78' Burnley are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Burnley.
78' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Burnley produce a short pass from the free kick.
77' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) steps up to send the ball in.

77' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Burnley move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. The linesman points to the corner flag, Burnley are going to take it.
76' Ivan Perisic is the provider with a good cross and Pedro Porro (Tottenham) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he fires a shot well wide of the left post.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Cork (Burnley) comes onto the pitch so that Jordan Beyer can be given a rest.
74' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
72' Here is a change. Heung-Min Son is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Richarlison (Tottenham).
71' Tottenham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
70' 2:10 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
68' It will be a substitution. Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) is ready to enter the pitch as Manor Solomon walks off.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Koleosho leaves the pitch and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) comes on.
68' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr will be replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
66' 1 - 5 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!

63' 1 - 4 Manor Solomon passes to Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes inside the right post. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:4.
62' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

62' The game is pretty dull as Tottenham are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but James Trafford has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
60' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Zeki Amdouni and he is replaced by Nathan Redmond (Burnley).
58' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) picks up a yellow card.
57' James Maddison (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

56' Lyle Foster (Burnley) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Guglielmo Vicario makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball is out of play. Burnley win a corner kick.

54' 1 - 3 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by James Maddison (Tottenham) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.

51' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly high over the crossbar. Unlucky finish. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
50' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

49' James Maddison (Tottenham) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom left corner, but it wasn't dangerous and James Trafford made a comfortable save.
47' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
46' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) replaces Johann Berg Gudmundsson.
46' Substitution. Sander Berge is replaced by Josh Brownhill (Burnley).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
45+4' Referee Darren England points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Tottenham players celebrate.
45+3' The Tottenham players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

45+2' 1 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of James Trafford, so the score changes to 1:2.
45+1' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

45+1' Tottenham are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' It seemed like Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
41' Darren England shows a yellow card to Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
38' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
38' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 3:3.

37' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the pass from Manor Solomon in his stride and from mid-range fires in a thunderous shot, but it lacks direction and goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
35' Tottenham are ruled offside.
35' James Maddison (Tottenham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by James Trafford stops the ball from going inside right post.
34' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

34' A through ball from Manor Solomon (Tottenham) fails to reach Destiny Udogie as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Destiny Udogie could have got into a promising position. Tottenham win a corner.
33' The ball possession is 49:51.
32' A pass by Manor Solomon (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
30' James Maddison (Tottenham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
30' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
28' The referee is firm and issues Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) a deserved yellow card.
28' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
27' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Heung-Min Son.
27' Tottenham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' 4:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.

24' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Lyle Foster, who is lurking close to the offside line. Lyle Foster (Burnley) is flagged for offside.
22' James Maddison (Tottenham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

22' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Burnley.

21' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
20' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) tries to find James Maddison, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
16' 1 - 1 Goal! Manor Solomon gets to the ball, slips Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 1:1.

16' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
16' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Burnley.
14' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
13' Tottenham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Dejan Kulusevski almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
8' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
6' 1 - 0 Goal Lyle Foster (Burnley)! Lyle Foster (Burnley) was put through by Luca Koleosho and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) heads on.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Burnley are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Darren England will supervise the game today.
